reply_text:
Found two issues:

*CRITICAL*
- *[P1] Printed prices are 100× too high* — `receipt/render.py:2` formats cents directly as dollars: `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`.
  *Fix:* Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-value assertions; `tests/test_render.py:10` currently uses the same broken formatter to calculate its expectation.

*INFORMATIONAL*
- *[P2] Receipt amounts aren’t right-aligned* — `receipt/render.py:7` fixes the label width, so amounts of different lengths end in different columns. The new 32-column `align()` helper is never called by the renderer.
  *Fix:* Use `align(line['name'], format_money(total))` and test rendered lines with different amount lengths.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
